Production path
indexed fields and (source ID, offset) anchors
observe fields; push and accept children
path root push retains exact indexed request view
EOF: borrow message prestate; require cursor at body end
path EOF: retain reducer result, indexed view, and checked stats
EPathMap EOF: indexed cursor image and checked stats; box source once
valid contiguous UTF-8: std scan; malformed or fragmented: indexed scan
finish using retained semantic slots and score arena
typed summary; bounded score handle
check nondecreasing score count and summary kind
map EOF: returned key has same indexed view
Complete: capture exact child result and suspended parent
pop one; score and resolution counts unchanged
Message stores exact typed occurrence; Map stores exact Par
EPathMap Push checks wait ID/kind, indexed child view, and descriptor
CanonicalPath Push checks wait ID/kind, indexed view, and descriptor
pushed Message/Map/EPathMap/CanonicalPath has fresh state
EPathMap return binds selected indexed child view, ID, and resolution
accept clears wait; checked resolution increment can overflow
root Complete checks retained source before empty-stack return
emit one borrowed checked event for each successful driver step

Found after the October audit: nine gaps closed in the Verus model, one bound of the Rocq references
live RootComplete takes the runtime root return; integrated_step (added 2026-11-09) adds CanonicalPath and ACT arms
G1 a root without a score completes: GL9, GL10, GL11 CLOSED
G1b a scored root outside the ten component families returns: GL1 CLOSED
G1c a root returns without a reachability premise: GL1 CLOSED
G2 a Var is always scored: GL2, GL6 CLOSED
G3 an EZipper is scored with a PathMap, unscored without: GL4, GL5, GL6, GL12, GL12f CLOSED
G4 an incomplete EMap has no score: GL5, GL8 CLOSED
G5 a raw-Par or nested EPathMap child returns into a waiting EPathMap parent: P1-L1 to P1-L8c CLOSED
G6 an accepted EPathMap owner is scored: GL3, GL6, GL7 CLOSED
G7 an EPathMap frame is built inside its push: P1-L9 CLOSED
CLOSED: every closing leaf has landed, so the model has a step
for the production behaviour. It is not a refinement proof;
the OPEN arrows below still stand.
follow-up witnesses for G3 (EZipper score trace) and for G5 and G7 (path-invariant cases) PENDING
recursive mixed reference equals the independent oracle; ACTree03 keys are opaque
EPM1 key-path grammar (EmptyPath refusal of an empty key) NOT MODELLED
universal Rust scalar Continue projection OPEN
universal Rust API binding for indexed regions OPEN
universal source-to-model EOF macro-step OPEN
complete checked-event to global product-action projection OPEN
universal child-step and reducer-EOF extraction OPEN
Indexed-region 10/0 and scalar/root 10/0 passed standalone Verus;
their Rust API and ghost pre/post bindings remain unproved.
Production evidence: four indexed position properties; final-source
r20 admission 134 passed (one ignored), CostTokenStack 5/5,
indexed protobuf 44/44; UTF-8 parity focused 1/1 (64 cases),
terminal focused 1/1, and post-fix 64 KiB focused 1/1.
EPathMap terminal 3/0, End selector 1/0, and MapKey full-source 4/0 passed focused
Verus; EPathMap-origin Push source action passed 1/0;
its live dispatch module passed 2/0 and integrated preservation 1/0;
guarded EpmEnd to NestedEpm1 return passed 3/0.
Push transport prefix passed 6/0 with a constrained linked-state witness.
Fresh-frame source: admission 135 passed (one ignored),
field-cursor property 1/1, CostTokenStack admission 5/5.
All retain source-extraction premises. The r13 gate
passed with five expected-failure causal mutants. Later source
changes require a final exact-commit gate.
The original one-entry EPathMap fixture had no nonmessage Continue/Push;
new Map-key and nested CanonicalPath fixtures cover finite examples only.
Universal Rust-to-formal binding is still open.
